name: SmartEco-Column
subtitle: Environmental monitoring through ESP32, MQTT, and a React dashboard
description: An ESP32 environmental monitoring prototype that streams air, soil, and water values through MQTT to a Node.js/WebSocket service and a React dashboard. Its MQTT-to-REST/WebSocket service is integration-tested, while CI also builds the dashboard.
imageAlt: SmartEco-Column dashboard with controlled air, soil, and water values in a connected local test state
architecture: ESP32 sensors → MQTT broker → Node.js service → WebSocket + REST → React dashboard
highlights: Publishes separate air, soil, and water sensor payloads from ESP32 firmware every three seconds.
Bridges MQTT data to browser clients through a Node.js WebSocket service and a REST snapshot endpoint.
Filters malformed, unexpected, and out-of-range sensor values in the integration-tested backend.
Builds the React dashboard and runs backend integration coverage through continuous integration.
note: Prototype status: physical sensor calibration and hardware testing are still required before field deployment.

name: Developer Portfolio
subtitle: Accessible, data-driven GitHub Pages portfolio
description: A lightweight, accessible GitHub Pages portfolio with data-driven project and certificate collections, responsive layouts, and a maintainable résumé system.
imageAlt: Joerelle Jay P. Bisnar portfolio social preview graphic
architecture: Semantic HTML → JSON content collections → vanilla JavaScript rendering → GitHub Pages
highlights: Loads projects, certificates, collaborative work, and skill evidence from maintainable JSON files.
Uses semantic HTML, keyboard-operable controls, visible focus states, and reduced-motion support.
Integrates an in-page résumé preview with direct open and download fallbacks.
Publishes directly from the repository root with no framework or build step.
note: Content claims and links are kept aligned with public repositories, certificates, and verified experience.
